test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that correctly expresses the following sentence in passive voice.

Who invited you to this party?

options.text: By whom you are invited to this party?
By whom are you invited to this party?
By whom you were invited to this party?
By whom were you invited to this party?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Who invited you to this party?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "you" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "invited" to "were invited" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "who".
 
• Ensure the question structure remains intact by placing "By whom" at the beginning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"By whom were you invited to this party?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"By whom you are invited to this party?" – Incorrect word order in the question.
 
• **Option 2: **"By whom are you invited to this party?" – Incorrect tense (present simple passive instead of past simple passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"By whom you were invited to this party?" – Incorrect word order in the question.
